banks.description: Certified Public Accountant (CPA) Official Exam Blueprint Questions 2024

questions.subject: المحاسبة المالية
options: الأصول = الخصوم + حقوق الملكية
الأصول = الإيرادات − المصروفات
الأصول + الخصوم = صفر
حقوق الملكية = الأصول × 2
questions.explanation: المعادلة: الأصول = الالتزامات + حقوق الملكية، وهي أساس القيد المزدوج.

questions.subject: أساس الاستحقاق
questions.text: ما الذي يميّز أساس الاستحقاق Accrual؟
options: إثبات الإيراد والمصروف عند تحققه لا عند النقد
الإثبات عند تحصيل النقد فقط
إهمال المصروفات
الاعتماد على النقد فقط
questions.explanation: أساس الاستحقاق يثبت العمليات عند تحققها لا عند تدفق النقد.

questions.subject: التدقيق
options: رأي غير معدّل، متحفّظ، معاكس، وامتناع عن الرأي
رأي واحد فقط
لا يصدر المدقق رأيًا
رأي إداري
questions.explanation: أراء المدقق: غير معدّل، متحفّظ (أهمية)، معاكس، أو الامتناع عن إبداء الرأي.

questions.subject: الأصول
questions.text: ما طرق إهلاك الأصول الثابتة الشائعة؟
options: القسط الثابت والمتناقص ووحدات الإنتاج
القسط الثابت فقط
المتوسط المرجّح
الاستحقاق الدوري
questions.explanation: تشمل الطرق القسط الثابت والمتناقص ووحدات الإنتاج، حسب نمط الاستفادة.

questions.subject: المعايير
questions.text: ما الفرق الجوهري بين IFRS وUS GAAP في جوهرهما؟
options: IFRS مبادئ عامة وGAAP أكثر تفصيلًا بالقواعد
لا فرق إطلاقًا
IFRS أمريكية
GAAP عالمية فقط
questions.explanation: IFRS يقترب من المبادئ العامة بينما US GAAP أكثر تفصيلًا بالقواعد الخاصة.

questions.subject: المحاسبة والتقرير المالي FAR
questions.text: Under US GAAP (ASC 606), revenue from a contract with a customer is recognized when or as the entity satisfies a performance obligation by:
options: Transferring a promised good or service to the customer (when customer obtains control)
Receiving cash payment in full from the customer
Signing the legally binding sales contract
Delivering the shipping bill of lading to the freight carrier
questions.explanation: Under ASC 606 / IFRS 15, revenue is recognized upon the transfer of control of the promised asset (good or service) to the customer, either over time or at a point in time.

questions.subject: التدقيق والتأكيد AUD
questions.text: In the Audit Risk Model: Audit Risk (AR) = Inherent Risk (IR) × Control Risk (CR) × Detection Risk (DR). If the auditor assesses the Risk of Material Misstatement (IR × CR) as HIGH, the auditor must:
options: Set Detection Risk (DR) to LOW and expand the scope and extent of substantive testing
Increase Detection Risk (DR) to reduce the volume of audit work
Immediately disclaim an opinion on the financial statements
Rely entirely on management inquiry without documentary verification
questions.explanation: When RMM (IR × CR) is high, the acceptable level of Detection Risk (DR) must be low to maintain overall Audit Risk at an acceptably low level, requiring more extensive, rigorous substantive testing.

questions.subject: الأوراق المالية القابلة للتداول FAR
questions.text: Under US GAAP (ASC 320), how are unrealized holding gains and losses on Available-for-Sale (AFS) debt securities reported?
options: In Other Comprehensive Income (OCI), net of tax, until realized
Directly in net income on the Income Statement
As an addition or deduction to Retained Earnings immediately
They are deferred and not recorded until the securities mature
questions.explanation: Unrealized gains and losses for Available-for-Sale (AFS) debt securities are excluded from earnings and reported in Other Comprehensive Income (OCI) within equity until sold or impaired.
questions.bankTitle: Uniform CPA Examination - Financial Accounting & Auditing 2024 (معتمد)

questions.subject: المحاسبة الحكومية FAR
questions.text: In state and local government accounting under GASB, governmental fund financial statements are prepared using which accounting basis and measurement focus?
options: Modified accrual basis of accounting with current financial resources measurement focus
Full accrual basis of accounting with economic resources measurement focus
Strict cash basis of accounting without receivables
Income tax basis of accounting
questions.explanation: Governmental funds (e.g., General Fund) use the modified accrual basis (revenues recognized when measurable and available) and current financial resources measurement focus.

questions.subject: التنظيم والتشريعات REG
questions.text: Under common law and the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC), which of the following elements is required to form a legally enforceable contract?
options: Offer, acceptance, legal consideration, capacity of parties, and legal purpose
A formal written notary seal regardless of mutual assent
Liquidated damages clause specified in advance
A minimum monetary value exceeding $10,000
questions.explanation: Essential elements of an enforceable contract are: mutual agreement (offer and acceptance), bargained-for consideration, contractual capacity, and legality of purpose.
